name: Nullframe SynthAdapt Underworld Complete Rig
description:
Engineered entirely for synthetic body proportions — elongated limb ratios, non-standard joint placement, torso geometry that doesn't map to human sizing. The rig consists of modular wrap-panels in matte graphite synthskin, secured by magnetic tension clips rather than conventional fasteners. A wide-shouldered longvest drapes over an adaptive underlayer that reshapes to the wearer's silhouette. No collar — most synthetics lack a conventional neck line. Foot wraps in grip-rubber adapt to non-standard foot geometry.

Nullframe's street reputation is built on this piece: it's the only ready-made underworld-adjacent look that doesn't require a synthetic to look like they're wearing something designed for a human.
functionality: Fully modular magnetic-clip assembly for non-human proportions, adaptive underlayer silhouette reshaping, grip-rubber non-standard foot wraps, no fixed collar or conventional sizing.
what_it_says: A synthetic who refuses to perform humanity for anyone's comfort — dressed for the street on their own terms.
story_hooks: Nullframe's designer is a synthetic who was denied entry to three tailors before building the brand — the corponation that manufactured them is trying to suppress the label.
A synthetic wearing this rig has been seen in Tier 5 spaces no synthetic should be able to access — someone is letting them through.
The magnetic clips use a proprietary frequency; a Nullframe piece can be remotely disassembled by anyone with the right signal device.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular silhouette designed for non-human proportions. The outfit presents as a modular adaptive system—wide-shouldered longvest with dramatic drape over form-fitting underlayer, creating an elongated, almost alien elegance. The absence of collar and standardized human framing reads as deliberately synthetic and street-forward.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered for synthetic body geometry: elongated limb channels, offset joint articulation points, non-standard torso accommodation. Compression underlayer molds to individual frame; vest floats with magnetic tension rather than clinging.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte graphite synthskin (primary wraps), adaptive polymesh underlayer (temperature-responsive, flex-supporting), grip-rubber foot wraps
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte finish on synthskin with subtle micro-texture for grip; underlayer has gentle ribbed compression weave; foot wraps feature raised tread pattern for traction on metal surfaces
physical_description.color_scheme: Monochromatic matte graphite gray with charcoal shadow accents along seams and joint articulation zones. No branding visible—purely functional aesthetic.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic tension clips (distributed across wrap-panels and vest seaming), friction-fit at wrist and ankle, no traditional buckles or zippers
distinctive_features: Modular magnetic wrap-panels allowing field reconfiguration
Collarless neckline designed for synthetic neck/shoulder geometry
Wide-cut longvest with weighted drape hem
Adaptive underlayer that reshapes to wearer's frame
Grip-rubber foot wraps scaled for non-standard foot proportions
Zero visible human-proportion assumptions in construction
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4–5 crossover: street-grade synthetic-exclusive design, expensive enough to signal serious underworld integration, not corpo-accessible
physical_description.cultural_context: Marks the wearer as post-human or synthetic-bodied, street-integrated, part of the Nullframe subculture. Wearing this is a statement: 'I don't fit human systems, and I'm done pretending.' Signals mechanical autonomy, underworld credentials, refusal of corpo assimilation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine out-of-manufacture; develops micro-scuffs and magnetic-clip patina with heavy use. Worn examples show wear on foot wraps and vest hem from regular street navigation.
